tells.2: The broad 'Whether you're...' audience paragraph and 'see how far you've come' feel like stock app-description copy.
tells.3: Stacked reassurance and vague promotional phrases: 'guidance you can trust,' 'BUILT FOR REAL RECOVERY,' and 'unlock more of what the app has to offer.'

reason: Version 2 best balances readable structure, concrete benefits, and a natural promotional voice; its added feature and subscription claims would need verification before publication. Version 4 is clear but flat, version 1 is personable but repetitive, and version 3 is the most formulaic.
